slides.body: five reasons georgia is a great first solo trip. save this post.

slides.head: why women travel here *alone*
slides.body: crime is low, prices are tiny - and solo guests get adopted. you will not eat dinner alone here unless you want to.

slides.head: the old town fits in *one walk*
slides.body: carved balconies, cobblestones, steaming sulfur domes. pushkin bathed here and called it the best bath of his life.

slides.head: the best *view*
slides.body: from narikala fortress the whole city lies under your feet. next to you: the mother of georgia statue - wine for guests, a sword for enemies.

slides.head: a tip most people *miss*
slides.body: skip taxis, the metro costs cents. and eat khinkali like a local: hold the topknot, never use a knife.

slides.head: one *easy* day trip
slides.body: mtskheta, the ancient capital, is 30 minutes away. taste amber wine from clay qvevri jars - georgians have made wine for 8,000 years.

slides.lead: five simple tips. one easier trip.
